description: This PHP class 'IncludeEmployee' extends 'FilterField' and defines logic for filtering employee records in reports, specifically handling null and not null termination records within a query builder context.

classes.name: IncludeEmployee
classes.description: A filter field class for including employees based on termination record nullity in report queries.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a 'WHERE' clause to the query builder based on the operator, filtering for null or not null employee termination records.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query joins, here 'employee'.
